messages:
mike: T-minus 22m. Change window opens at 15:00 UTC. final handoff start pls.

jane: rolling /release/v3.4.2 -> prod. pinned model family: redwood-v1-8b-q4f16. no pin exceptions.

sara: noted. rollback owners: sara (svc), niko (infra). if canary fails we roll to v3.4.1 and throttle traffic.

mike: double-checking: any outstanding migration jobs?

sara: DB migration (feature_flags) completed 30m ago, migration-runner shows SUCCESS. config rollout in progress but staged to 5% only.

jane: release notes snippet -> "Fixes: KV-cache leak under long-lived sessions; Perf: better batching heuristics for short seqs; Ops: improved deploybot rollforward hooks"

mike: cool. last-minute checklist: smoke tests, latency SLOs, cost guard, deploybot pin list, incident rotation. who has paging?

niko: I'm on paging for first 60m. sara on next 60m. ops-bot will double notify.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: /deploy v3.4.2 -> prod-canary (10 nodes). Canary window 10m. Logs: https://ci.internal/deploy/4461234567

jane: starting canary smoke: curl -sS https://api.redwood/prod/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' | jq '.choices[0].text'

sara: smoke looks fine on a few prompts. latency 85ms p95, token cost within expected.

deploy-bot: Canary health: OK. error-rate 0.2% (<0.5%), latency p95 90ms. continuing rollout to 30%.

mike: bump to 60% only if no alerts in next 6m. hold for canary metrics and any abnormal CPU/GPU mem.

niko: seeing transient GPU mem growth on node canary-07, investigating.

jane: if GPU mem continues, plan: pause rollout, pin traffic back to v3.4.1, and mark node for repro. rollback owner niko.

sara: adding rollback playbook snippet: ```steps:
1) /deploy rollback v3.4.2 -> v3.4.1
2) revoke canary route, drain affected nodes
3) open incident channel #inc-4461
4) capture heap/profile from node
```

ops-bot: Reminder: freeze window active until 16:30 UTC. No config changes outside emergency path.

mike: Taking a snapshot of canary logs and saving a release artifact. @jane can you add release_notes.md to the artifact?

jane: uploaded release_notes.md and changelog to the artifact bucket: s3://release-artifacts/4461234567/v3.4.2/

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 60% complete. No new alerts.

niko: node canary-07 mem stabilized after driver gc. monitoring steady.

mike: good. proceed to 100% after 4m quiet period.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: v3.4.2 -> prod (100%). Post-deploy checks running (smoke, latency, error-rate).

sara: post-deploy smoke PASS. latency p95 92ms, errors 0.25%. cost per token within 2% of expected.

mike: closing handoff. recording: freeze stays until 16:30 UTC per ops-bot. if anything regresses, follow rollback playbook and notify on-call. :thumbsup:

jane: tagging changelog and release notes in the release ticket: https://go/release/4461234567

ops-bot: Incident watch window started. Pager rules active for 60m.

niko: I'll keep an eye for the next 60m and report any anomalies.

mike: thanks team — great job.
